notes: Authoritative source: official Panamax/Nice M4315-PRO User Guide (Nice acquired Panamax; current manual is co-branded "Nice"). Rear panel has 8 individually-controlled NEMA 5-15R outlets grouped into 4 filter-isolated banks (Banks 1-3 = outlets 1-6, linear-filtered; Bank 4 = outlets 7-8, high-current); front panel adds 1 always-on NEMA 5-15R outlet. CATV/SAT 1 & 2 are bidirectional coax surge-protection pass-through jacks (Female F-type, 75V clamping, 0Hz-2.2GHz) - no bandwidth grade applies per the given SDI/coax scale so grade omitted. Telco IN/OUT are RJ-11 analog phone/DSL surge-protection pass-through jacks; RJ-11 is not in the provided connector enum, so "rj45" is used as the closest listed 8P8C-family id even though the real connector is the smaller 6P2C RJ-11 - flagged here as a caveat. LAN Cat5e port is an Ethernet surge-protection pass-through rated 10/100/1000BASE-T, graded eth-1g. DC Trigger Input is a 3.5mm mono mini-jack (5-24VDC trigger sense input); modeled as trs-3.5 as the closest connector id (physically a mono/TS 1/8" plug). The internal TCP/IP BlueBOLT-CV3 control card's RJ-45 network port (item 8 on rear panel diagram) is listed separately from the LAN Cat5e pass-through port; its exact speed grade is not stated in the datasheet so eth-100m is used as a conservative inferred grade (BlueBOLT-CV3 is a 10/100 control card per Nice/Panamax accessory literature) - this is an inferred value, not spec-confirmed. Unit ships rack-mountable (1U, removable rack ears) but can also sit on shelf feet (rubber feet included).
